result.title: SpatialBrain: Spatial Intelligence Growing from Experience
result.summary: Spatial reasoning requires more than access to geometric tools: a reasoner must decide when direct observation is sufficient and when to reconstruct, measure, or change reference frames. We present SpatialBrain, a framework that retains experience about these decisions while keeping its vision-language backbone fixed. The key distinction is between evidence about a scene and experience about how to reason with that evidence. 3DFusionMemory fuses current-scene observations into queryable spatial relations. A Spatial Skill Library provides reusable tool procedures, and Spatial Cognition associates task conditions with experience about when and how to use memory and skills. Completed trajectories are abstracted into process records and consolidated between task blocks, allowing later decisions to draw on earlier execution without transferring scene coordinates or reference answers. Across five spatial-reasoning benchmarks, SpatialBrain improves on direct answers from the same backbone on four and ties on the fifth. Component comparisons, experience-coverage curves, and traced resource decisions characterize how the framework accumulates and uses these resources.

AI.brief_summary: SpatialBrain 在固定的 VLM 主干下积累「如何推理」的经验：3DFusionMemory 把当前观测融合为可查询的空间关系，技能库提供可复用工具流程，Spatial Cognition 将任务条件与何时使用记忆和技能的经验关联，完成轨迹被抽象为过程记录并在任务块之间整合；在五个空间推理基准上四个优于同主干直接回答，一个持平。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时直接观察已足够、何时需重构、测量或切换参考系」的决策正对应 LOOK/STOP 与视觉证据筛选，过程记录到经验整合的流程可供核查停止与工具调用的经验式监督；但方法不涉及 latent 状态的生成与更新。
